groups.title: Hyperscaler AI Infrastructure Capital Spending
groups.scope: Aggregate capital expenditure by the five largest cloud service providers and other hyperscalers for AI infrastructure, including estimates and ranges for 2026.

groups.title: NVIDIA FY2027 Financial Outlook
groups.scope: NVIDIA FY2027 financial performance and investment metrics, including total and segment revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, tax rates, and capital expenditure.

groups.title: NVIDIA–SK AI Factory Partnership and Deployment
groups.scope: Formalization and implementation of NVIDIA and SK Group or SK Telecom cooperation involving AI factory construction, NVIDIA platforms, accelerated computing, and AI memory supply.

groups.title: NVIDIA Gaming Technology Support in Game Releases
groups.scope: Availability of NVIDIA gaming technologies, including DLSS and Reflex, in specific PC game tests or releases for GeForce RTX players.

groups.title: Company-Level Hyperscaler AI Infrastructure Capital Spending
groups.scope: Individual hyperscaler company capital expenditure outlooks for 2026, including spending on data centers, servers, networking, and financing-lease principal payments.

groups.title: AMD AI Accelerator Platform Commercialization Milestones
groups.scope: Commercial rollout milestones for AMD AI infrastructure platforms, including initial Helios shipments and the start of large-scale MI450 deployments.

groups.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark Software and Management Support
groups.scope: Availability of software compatibility and system-monitoring tools for NVIDIA DGX Spark and related clusters.

groups.title: NVIDIA Data Center Power Infrastructure Products
groups.scope: Launches of NVIDIA data center power infrastructure products, including MGX-compatible high-voltage DC power racks and row power centers.
